guest.cinder.delight: Warm all the way to my tail.
guest.dragon.helper_text: Warm laundry: finishes a wash, or adds clean linen.
guest.dragon.name: Dragon
guest.dragon.quirk_text: If too chilly, a warm hiccup heats the room and its open-vent neighbours.
guest.ghost.helper_text: Gentle delivery: floats a waiting towel or snack to its own request.
guest.ghost.name: Ghost
guest.ghost.quirk_text: Noise over 20 is a little much. A disturbed ghost floats a nearby towel to its room.
guest.moonwolf.helper_text: Humming along: gives waiting guests 10 more seconds of patience.
guest.moonwolf.name: Moonwolf
guest.moonwolf.quirk_text: Breathes in, then sings one big note. Curtains make the note small for the neighbours.
guest.slime.helper_text: Slipstream: dries up to three nearby puddles.
guest.slime.name: Slime
guest.slime.quirk_text: A happy wiggle sometimes flips a slipper. Slimes leave little puddles when they walk — until their slippers arrive.
guest.sprout.helper_text: Little bloom: adds humidity and dries one puddle.
guest.sprout.name: Sprout
guest.sprout.quirk_text: Very damp rooms make it bloom so happily that a puddle appears.
guest.whisp.delight: A wonderfully quiet sort of lovely.
guest.yeti.helper_text: Cool company: cools the room and adds a snack to the tin.
guest.yeti.name: Yeti

level.L01.blurb: The very first guests are on their way. Greet them, pick a room, and bring the slippers.
level.L01.mid: They fit both of my feet!
level.L01.payoff: Mallow proudly shows a slipper on a temporary third foot, then realizes it belongs on the other side.
level.L01.postcard: That is a very good beginning.
level.L01.purpose: Complete the first small welcome shift. Teach recognition and shared supplies, not speed.
level.L01.title: First Bell
level.L02.blurb: Everybody wants a fresh towel at once! One of you can be the runner.
level.L02.mid: (Gus presents his towel-cape with a proud squeak.)
level.L02.payoff: A towel folds itself around Mallow like a dignified little cape. Gus imitates the pose with a dishcloth.
level.L02.postcard: Help can come from either direction.
level.L02.purpose: Introduce overlapping service requests and the usefulness of a runner.
level.L02.title: Towels, Please
level.L03.blurb: Strip the beds, wash the sheets and make every room cozy again.
level.L03.mid: (Gus leans beside the folded sheet and matches its shape exactly.)
level.L03.payoff: A clean sheet emerges with a perfect Gus-shaped fold, which Gus treats as a flattering portrait.
level.L03.purpose: Make the room-reset loop a satisfying team activity.
level.L03.title: Laundry Day
level.L04.blurb: A festival trunk turns up in the lobby. It is long, wobbly and nicer to carry with a friend.
level.L04.mid: (The tiny suitcase unfolds one tiny handle, proudly.)
level.L04.payoff: The trunk opens at its destination to reveal an even smaller suitcase wearing a bow tie.
level.L04.postcard: Big jobs get smaller when we share them.
level.L04.purpose: Introduce optional shared carrying while keeping the normal hotel readable.
level.L04.title: A Very Long Suitcase
level.L05.blurb: A yeti checks in. Yetis like it cool, so watch the radiators.
level.L05.mid: (A frozen ornament goes “ting…k.” Flurry gives it an apologetic wave.)
level.L05.payoff: Flurry sneezes into a mitten. A snowflake-shaped tissue floats down and folds itself.
level.L05.purpose: Introduce cold comfort with only one new environmental need at a time.
level.L05.title: Some Like It Chilly
level.L06.blurb: A dragon and a yeti on the same floor. Toasty here, chilly there — plan the rooms together.
level.L06.mid: (A sock-shaped cloud drifts past both luggage tags.)
level.L06.payoff: Cinder and Flurry compare their travel hats; the hats agree on neither the weather nor their own size.
level.L06.postcard: (Dot adds a second column to her checklist.)
level.L06.purpose: Give the signature room-planning decision its first full expression.
level.L06.title: Hot and Cold Running Guests
level.L07.blurb: Warm puffs keep drifting down the hall. Find the vent that started it.
level.L07.mid: (Dot solemnly fans the nearest pipe… then notices the real lever.)
level.L07.payoff: Dot tries using her checklist as a fan; it cools only her own eyebrows.
level.L07.purpose: Teach source tracing: solve the cause, then clear the visible mess.
level.L07.title: Mind the Vents
level.L08.blurb: Frost on the doors, steam in the hall and guests at the desk. A big day on Radiator Row.
level.L08.mid: (Gus shows off his static-fluffed towel eyebrows.)
level.L08.payoff: Gus rolls into a warm towel, emerges with static-fluffed eyebrows, and looks immensely pleased.
level.L08.postcard: Cinder dries the scarf while Flurry cools the drinks.
level.L08.purpose: Combine warm/cold control, door recovery, and ordinary service into a chapter capstone.
level.L08.title: The Great Defrost
level.L09.blurb: A ghost would love a quiet room. Let's find one.
level.L09.mid: (Whisp's sheet eyebrows rise… then settle as the note fades.)
level.L09.payoff: Whisp mistakes a towel for formalwear, then adds a tiny bow.
level.L09.postcard: Whisp naps under a moon mask. A towel bow hangs on the hook.
level.L09.purpose: Introduce quiet comfort without a mandatory noisy guest in the same wave.
level.L09.title: Please Do Disturb
level.L10.blurb: Luna loves to sing and Whisp loves to snooze. Curtains help them both.
level.L10.mid: (Luna smiles proudly at the tiny note and mouths “perfect.”)
level.L10.payoff: A grand howl emerges on the quiet side as a squeak so small that Gus leans in to hear it.
level.L10.postcard: A big note and a little moon hang on the same welcome sign.
level.L10.purpose: Let a singer and a sleeper coexist through room choice and acoustic control.
level.L10.title: Indoor Voices
level.L11.blurb: Warm guests, cool guests and quiet guests. Use vents and curtains together.
level.L11.mid: (Dot checks the correct symbol before touching the switch.)
level.L11.payoff: Gus wears an acoustic curtain as a cape; a tiny fabric corner reveals where he is hiding.
level.L11.purpose: Combine acoustic planning with the already-known thermal system.
level.L11.title: Curtain Confidence
level.L12.blurb: A little concert in the lobby! Keep the quiet rooms quiet while the music plays.
level.L12.mid: (Three towel puppets bow at three different times. Luna loves it.)
level.L12.payoff: Luna conducts three towel puppets. They all bow at different times, and she loves the result.
level.L12.purpose: Run a small hotel concert while preserving quiet rooms.
level.L12.title: The Quiet-ish Concert
level.L13.blurb: A sprout arrives at the conservatory. A sprinkle of water makes it happy.
level.L13.payoff: Fern’s first flower opens a leaf umbrella above one drop of water, then proudly puts it away.
level.L13.purpose: Teach watering as a readable comfort action and preserve a relaxed first encounter.
level.L13.title: A Little Water
level.L14.blurb: Steam, sprouts and a dragon. Damp rooms are lovely — for some guests.
level.L14.mid: (Fern offers the watering-can-shaped cloud a tiny flower.)
level.L14.payoff: A steam cloud resembles a watering can; Fern offers it a tiny flower before it drifts away.
level.L14.postcard: Warm and cool cups beside a thriving potted plant.
level.L14.purpose: Combine humidity with hot/cold room planning without adding another resource system.
level.L14.title: Steam and Sprouts
level.L15.blurb: Puddles everywhere. Grab a mop and help each other stay on your feet.
level.L15.mid: (Two mop heads leave a heart-shaped dry patch.)
level.L15.payoff: Two mop heads leave a heart-shaped dry patch. Mallow tries to autograph it and briefly becomes a heart too.
level.L15.postcard: Mop handles form a little arch over a perfectly ordinary dry floor.
level.L15.purpose: Turn cleanup into a small rescue opportunity rather than a punishment.
level.L15.title: Puddle Buddies
level.L16.blurb: All six kinds of guests at once. The conservatory is in full bloom.
level.L16.mid: (A flower crown lands on Gus's handle.)
level.L16.payoff: Fern’s flower crowns land on guests at delightfully unsuitable angles; Whisp’s crown hovers a little too high.
level.L16.purpose: Finish the conservatory with all six families represented in solo as well as co-op.
level.L16.title: Bloom Service
level.L17.blurb: The shutter in the split lobby opens and closes. There is always a way around.
level.L17.mid: (Gus simply walks the lower route and politely waves.)
level.L17.payoff: Dot waits ceremoniously for the shutter, while Gus simply walks the lower route and politely waves.
level.L17.postcard: Two arrows curve around the divider and meet at a heart.
level.L17.purpose: Introduce a route choice while keeping a permanent, generous bypass.
level.L17.title: The Other Side
level.L18.blurb: The luggage lift is open for business. Send towels across instead of walking.
level.L18.mid: (Gus rides the lift facing the wrong way and comes back with a sightseeing postcard.)
level.L18.payoff: Gus rides the lift facing the wrong way, exits with a tiny sightseeing postcard, and is thrilled.
level.L18.postcard: Two lift symbols frame a towel with a travel sticker.
level.L18.purpose: Introduce lifts as an optional logistics shortcut and a useful handoff location.
level.L18.title: Express-ish Delivery
level.L19.blurb: Some guests would love a new view. Move them to a happier room.
level.L19.mid: (The moving guest pauses to admire the same hallway from a new angle.)
level.L19.payoff: The moving guest carries a tiny Do Not Disturb sign labeled “Exploring.”
level.L19.postcard: One guest points between two windows with equal delight.
level.L19.purpose: Show relocation as a strategic rescue that preserves a guest’s visit history.
level.L19.title: A Change of View
level.L19.view: A guest would love a new view. Try Move Room at their door.
level.L20.blurb: A very big delivery for the festival, right through a very busy hotel.
level.L20.mid: (The tiny instruction card unfurls into an unexpectedly long ribbon: “This way up.”)
level.L20.payoff: The first trunk contains a huge folded moon. The second contains one tiny instruction card: “This way up,” with arrows in every direction.
level.L20.purpose: Bring festival equipment through a working hotel and make asking for help feel good.
level.L20.title: The Big Little Delivery
level.L21.blurb: Hang the lanterns and welcome the guests — the festival is nearly here.
level.L21.mid: (A background lantern briefly wears Gus's bellhop cap.)
level.L21.payoff: A lantern tries on Gus’s cap. Gus tries on the lantern’s tassel.
level.L21.postcard: Three lit lanterns beneath the paper moon.
level.L21.purpose: Decorate a lively hotel using only familiar carrying and room systems.
level.L21.title: Lantern Check-In
level.L22.blurb: Happy guests like to help. Spot their ideas and say yes.
level.L22.mid: (Dot offers to hold the clipboard. Gus hands her a towel instead. She beams.)
level.L22.payoff: Dot offers to help by holding the clipboard. Gus hands her a towel instead. She beams.
level.L22.postcard: Guests and staff each hold one small contribution to the festival.
level.L22.purpose: Reward recognizing what happy guests can contribute, without making helpers mandatory.
level.L22.title: Neighbors Helping Neighbors
level.L23.blurb: Every room is full and everyone is kind. The busiest day yet.
level.L23.mid: (The bell hiccups. Dot answers with an equally serious hiccup.)
level.L23.payoff: The lobby bell hiccups during a very serious clipboard check. Dot answers with an equally serious hiccup.
level.L23.postcard: (Dot leaves the clipboard on a hook and joins the group.)
level.L23.purpose: Provide the campaign’s busiest conventional shift before a celebratory finale.
level.L23.title: A Full House, Kindly
level.L24.blurb: The festival night. There's room for everyone.
level.L24.mid: (Guests begin a small, happy, in-place celebration.)
level.L24.payoff: Gus’s camera takes a photo of his own lid first. The second photo includes everyone. A missing parcel is placed by Nana in the wrap montage without withholding the ending.
level.L24.postcard: Hearth & Hiccup — room for one more.
level.L24.purpose: End with shared competence and a generous celebration, using no new mechanic.
level.L24.title: Room for Everyone

story.B01.3: I may need a wider checklist.

story.E00.2: (Flurry offers a chilled cup. Cinder offers a warm biscuit.)
story.E00.3: ♪  (a gentle song on one side, a gentle nap on the other)  ♪
story.E00.4: I knew I packed a spare.
story.E00.5: I think I understand the important part now.

story.O00.2: And, if we do our jobs…
story.O00.4b: I was hoping you'd say that.
story.O00.5: Beds. Towels. One standard room temperature. How hard could it be?
story.O00.6: We may need more than one kind of welcome.
story.O00.8: ROOM FOR TROUBLE — There's room for one more.

tut.T01.1: A little room to move. Walk through both glowing circles.
tut.T01.2: A fresh bed first! Take clean linen from the shelf, then use Work at room A's bed.
tut.T01.3: I've brought my best feet! Take my ticket and check me in to room A.
tut.T01.4: The kiosk has slippers ready. Take a pair and place them on Mallow's little table.
tut.T01.5: Mallow would love a towel. Take one from the rack and deliver it.
tut.T01.5m: Mallow would love a towel. Try handing it to a friend first — then deliver it!
tut.T01.6: What a stay! Use Work on Mallow to wave goodbye.
tut.T01.7: You can finish what a friend starts. Strip the bed, wash the sheets, mop, and make the bed.
tut.T01.final: Rooms get ready. Guests get comfortable. Helpers get things done together.
tut.T01.title: A Place for Your Bags
tut.T02.1: Hold Inspect to see what Flurry and Cinder like.
tut.T02.2: Check them in to rooms A and B — either way round.
tut.T02.3: The room can do the steady part. Set one thermostat Cool and one Toasty.
tut.T02.4: Hot and cold meet in the pipe! Close the vent gate between A and B.
tut.T02.5: Take the Breezer and fan the steam away.
tut.T02.6: A little frost at room C. Scrape it with Work — the door never fully closes.
tut.T02.final: Gates separate shared conditions. Not every neighbour needs one closed.
tut.T02.title: Warm on One Side, Cool on the Other
tut.T03.1: Check Whisp and Luna in to rooms A and D.
tut.T03.2: Luna is breathing in… watch the note travel to the room across the hall.
tut.T03.3: Hang a quiet curtain at either room. Take one from the return shelf drawer.
tut.T03.4: Let's try that once more. Ring the bell and watch the note shrink.
tut.T03.5: Ping to tell your team, then deliver Whisp's towel.
tut.T03.6: There's room for a song and a nap. Ring the bell when you're ready.
tut.T03.final: Curtains make sound small. Vents share warm and cool. Different little helpers.
tut.T03.title: A Song and a Nap
tut.nana_helps: Here, let me show you that one.
